notes.title: 18+ Patch Live - Play for Queens and Bounty
notes.notes:
Yo Dawgs!

Good news! The 18+ Adult Patch for King of Queendoms has been approved and is now live! Y'all can now enjoy the game the way it was intended. Now where did y'all leave that box of tissues lying around...

https://store.steampowered.com/app/967981/King_of_Queendoms_18_Adults_Only_Patch/

Have fun, dawgs!

Also remember, if y'all have time, ol' Uncle Ricky would appreciate it very much if you could leave a review. It allows the good people at Valve to evaluate my game and allow me to put in trading cards for y'all. Uncle Ricky knows you like a naughty memnto of your time playing the game. A review also gives other potential buyers a taste of what to expect so they can buy with confidence and join the King Key family!

PSST: King of Bali is getting trading cards! We are just getting them approved, thanks to our fans' legendary support.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/678190/King_of_Bali/

Peace!

Ricky

notes.title: Adults Only 18+ Patch Delay
notes.notes:
Yo Dawgs,

I think I owe some of y'all an apology. Looks like I made a small mistake with the NSFW patch and it did not approved for launch on time. This is my fault. My bad, dawgs. This is on ol' Uncle Ricky.

I've contacted the good people of Steam to try to get it out to y'all as soon as possible but we've been advised that they will not approve it for the weekend until they can do their final checks on the juicy stuff we have in store for you. For now please wait a lil' until you play the game. I assure you that the wait will be worth it.

Again, I'm real sorry, Uncle Ricky will get that out to y'all as soon as possible.

Peace,

Ricky
